name: std::char_traits<char>::find, std::char_traits<wchar_t>::find, std::char_traits<char8_t>::find, std::char_traits<char16_t>::find, std::char_traits<char32_t>::find

declarations.code:
static const char_type *

find(const char_type *ptr, std::size_t count, const char_type &ch);

intro:
Searches for character ch within the first count characters of the sequence pointed to by ptr.

See CharTraits for the general requirements on character traits for X::find.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ptr

 -

 pointer to a character string to search


 count

 -

 the number of characters to analyze


 ch

 -

 the character to search for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer to the first character in the range specified by [ptr, ptr + count) that compares equal to ch, or a null pointer if not found.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.

summary: Searches for character ch within the first count characters of the sequence pointed to by ptr.
